intro.title: Event Handling
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple interactive button component that changes its appearance when clicked. You will learn the core concept of event handling in React, which allows your application to respond to user actions like clicks. The main technologies involved are React's onClick event handler and TypeScript for type-safe function definitions. By the end, you'll understand how to capture events and update the UI dynamically in a React TypeScript application.
intro.usecase: Event handling is fundamental to every interactive web application. In real-world React applications, you'll use event handlers for form submissions in login screens, button clicks in e-commerce checkout flows, and input changes in search filters. Developers implement event handling when building interactive dashboards with real-time data updates, modal windows with close buttons, and navigation menus with hover effects. Mastering event handling allows you to create responsive UIs that react to user actions in applications like project management tools, social media platforms, and financial analytics dashboards.
